messages:
Alex H: Hey infra folks — I put together a concise Eviction SOPS + QA Playbook for our mixed spot/on-demand GPU pools. Wanted a quick pass from ops and QA before I promote to /runbooks. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eviction-sops (draft)

Priya R: Nice! Quick skim — a couple gaps: preflight health checks, an explicit rollback/unschedule step, and a clear decision tree for when to failover to on-demand.

Alex H: Agreed. I added a high-level decision tree in section 2 but left the commands TODO. Thinking to include: node cordon/drain, pod disruption budget checks, kscale override, and ASG/instance group failover.

Danny M: Add concrete commands we actually use. Example:

```
# cordon + drain with podgrace for GPU jobs
kubectl cordon NODE_NAME
kubectl drain NODE_NAME --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m
```

Also include how to force-evict long-running training pods safely (drain with PV handling, checkpoint sync).

Emma S: QA: we need a nightly chaos job that simulates preemptions, not just a one-off. Add an automated test that kills a random 10-20% of spot nodes and validates recovery within SLOs. Track token cost delta too.

Alex H: Good call. Drafted a minimal test harness in the doc: a k8s Job that picks nodes with label pool=spot-gpu and drains them one at a time, then waits for pod readiness. It also emits a report: recovery_time, failed_pods, fallback_on_demand_count.

Priya R: Important: include checks for taints/tolerations. Our worker jobs tolerate spot-taint but some infra pods should not. Add a preflight script to list pods that will be affected:

```
# list non-daemon pods on node
kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=NODE_NAME -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}\n{end}'
```

That helps devs know what will move.

Danny M: Escalation path: page on-call if recovery_time > 15m or if > 5% of running GPUs lost to eviction and autoscaler didn't provision new nodes. Add pager: infra-oncall -> eng-leads -> platform-sre. Also include Slack snippet to run when paging: `/page infra oncall: spot-eviction threshold breach`

Emma S: Add QA acceptance criteria for the playbook change:
- runbook reviewed by ops + eng + qa
- chaos test passes for two weeks in staging
- no more than 3% job failures attributable to evacuations

Alex H: Done. Also added cost guardrails: if fallback_on_demand_count > 50% for > 1h, auto-disable spot pool and notify cost team. Need an approval flow for auto-disable.

Priya R: For cloud specifics, include short notes: GCP preemptible vs AWS Spot difference (preemption signal timing, termination-notice hook), and recommended spot-vs-on-demand ratio per region. Don't prescribe exact numbers — suggest starting at 70/30 for training batch jobs and 30/70 for latency-sensitive inference GPUs.

Danny M: We should also document metrics to watch in Console: node_preemptions, node_recover_time, pending_pod_count, cost_delta_24h. Add alert rules with runbook link. Example alert:

```
ALERT SpotEvictionSurge
IF increase(node_preemptions[5m]) > 5
FOR 2m
LABELS { severity="page" }
ANNOTATIONS { summary="Spot eviction surge in cluster", runbook="https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eviction-sops" }
```

Alex H: Nice. Included an explicit checklist for manual drain:
1) Verify target node is in spot pool and tagged correctly
2) Check PDBs impact: `kubectl get pdb -A`
3) Cordon node
4) Drain node with `--grace-period=...`
5) Monitor pod rollout and GPU reclaim
6) If rollout stalls > 15m -> escalate/page

Emma S: QA will add a dry-run mode for the test harness and script to generate the report. Also want a staging smoke job that runs the largest training job we have to ensure model checkpointing works under evacuation.

Priya R: One more thing: fallback images and model checkpoints should be on a distributed store (S3/GCS/NFS) and checkpoint frequency documented per job type. Add a short table: ephemeral-job vs checkpoint-every-epoch vs continuous-snapshot.

ops-bot: Runbook updated: eviction-sops-v1.0-draft by Alex H. /runbooks/eviction-sops (migrated to drafts).

Danny M: LGTM from infra. I'll add the alert rules to staging Grafana tomorrow.

Emma S: LGTM from QA pending test harness merge.

Alex H: Thanks — I'll integrate the changes and ping again when it's promoted to stable. If anyone wants to pair on the automation, ping me or @Danny M. :thumbsup:
